criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First line is a concrete, dated decision-as-hook naming subject and the four affected hubs, and line 2 states the binary he owned. Falls just short of 10 because role (SVP) does not land until line 3, outside the first two lines.

criteria.name: Subject + decision load-bearing for AK
criteria.notes: Real decision-owner at Alaska's largest carrier; concrete consequence with named hubs, health/education/public-safety traffic, and 2026 timeframe. Held off 10 because the AI stake is genuinely peripheral (middle-mile transport, not AI capital/compute/power), so the AI-specific load is thinner than the data-infrastructure load.

criteria.name: Subject identification fidelity
criteria.notes: Full name, role, org, and Anchorage HQ tie all match the dossier exactly; every subject fact traceable. Anchorage tie is established via HQ and bowl-affecting decision rather than an explicit Wailand-resides-in-Anchorage line.

criteria.name: Decision specificity + primary-source
criteria.notes: What, when, and binary all named (buy Starlink LEO outage recovery vs build GCI-owned terrestrial/GEO redundancy), traces to GCI primary plus independent Telecompetitor, date in window. Short of 10 only because attribution is by outlet name rather than an embedded primary-source URL.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: Clear, non-mushy position: low-regret on the merits, with the honest tension being single-vendor dependency concentration. Grounded and proportionate, but the pro/con framing is a touch less inventive than post_001's sharper structural reframe.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Names the next decision Wailand/GCI own (extension beyond four hubs and on what SpaceX terms) and concrete triggers to watch (disclosed dollar figure, duration, middle-mile tariff or RDOF/BEAD filing). Held off 10 because no specific date or window is given.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, Alaska-first, plainspoken, business-literate; no press-release cadence, no hagiography, no influencer tics. Matches the post_001 register closely.

criteria.name: Engagement question
